verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs describe public, web-public and private channels, with subscription controlling which conversations appear for each member. Topics organize multiple conversations within a channel, and role-based rules apply, such as guests being unable to self-subscribe to public channels and advanced roles and permissions being included. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how admins add or remove members of private channels or restrict channel creation, and independent hands-on corroboration of the membership controls.
